text: Entry Requirements High school graduate To enter the first year: Studied Chinese for more than half year, be able to listen, speak, read and write in Chinese; To enter the second year: HSK level 4 scored 180 or above. Be able to listen, speak, read and write in Chinese; To enter the third year: HSK level 5 scored 180 or above. Be able to listen, speak, read and write in Chinese
